release_licenses.paper: venue-compatible open-access license selected before submission

source_rule.default: permit established research datasets for internal training unless their binding terms explicitly prohibit commercial training or public model-weight release
source_rule.guarded_web_use: accept Common Crawl and underlying-page residual rights risk for training while preserving source metadata, attribution, removal, deny-ledger, and rebuild controls
source_rule.generated_data: accept released synthetic datasets while citing disclosed generator families and recording missing exact generator or seed lineage as a limitation
source_rule.code: retain conservative permissive-license filters and available repository/file attribution metadata
source_rule.future_source: a source with explicit non-commercial, no-training, no-commercial-model, or no-public-weight terms requires exclusion or a new human policy decision

metadata: filters, deduplication, decontamination, and removal policy

required_controls: retain dataset revision and original URL repository or document identity where supplied
publish dataset-level citations and required attribution notices
preserve available per-file and per-document license metadata internally
maintain URL domain repository blob and content-hash deny ledgers
provide a public removal contact before model release
rebuild future packed shards after verified removal or rights corrections
record upstream takedowns and material term changes without rewriting frozen evidence
state known missing or unreliable rights metadata as a limitation
non_conclusions: the Apache-2.0 model license overrides source-dataset or underlying-content terms
non-redistribution of corpus bytes eliminates every training or model-output rights risk
public availability or dataset-level licensing proves ownership of every record
this project policy is legal advice or a warranty of non-infringement
